package com.example.integration.generated

import com.pandulapeter.kubriko.Kubriko
import com.pandulapeter.kubriko.actor.Actor
import com.pandulapeter.kubriko.audioPlayback.MusicManager
import com.pandulapeter.kubriko.audioPlayback.SoundManager
import com.pandulapeter.kubriko.collision.CollisionManager
import com.pandulapeter.kubriko.keyboardInput.KeyboardInputManager
import com.pandulapeter.kubriko.manager.Manager
import com.pandulapeter.kubriko.sprites.SpriteManager
import kotlin.concurrent.Volatile

/**
 * What Kubriko needs from the types built in Kubriko Creator.
 */
object KubrikoWiring {

    /**
     * Whether the Log Blocks log. Kubriko Creator turns it on while it plays the game (`Main.kt` reads it from the
     * `kubriko.creator.logging` system property); a released game leaves it off, since every log allocates.
     */
    var isLoggingEnabled = false

    /**
     * The Scene the game starts with instead of the one `Game.kt` names, when Kubriko Creator plays it from a Scene (`Main.kt`
     * reads it from the `kubriko.creator.scene` system property); null in a released game.
     */
    var firstSceneOverride: String? = null

    /**
     * The game's running Kubriko instances: `Game.kt` adds its own while it is shown, and `GameEntryPoint` reports them, so
     * that Kubriko Creator can wait until the game has drawn its Actors.
     */
    @Volatile
    var runningInstances: List<Kubriko> = emptyList()

    /**
     * Creates the Managers of every Manager type built in Kubriko Creator, the one that loads Scenes (and the one that plays
     * sounds and music, if the game does), and those of the plugins the game uses, for Kubriko.newInstance.
     *
     * @param isInSceneEditor True in the Scene editor, where their Events don't run, no Scene is loaded, and the plugins'
     *   Managers are left to the editor (except the one that draws sprites, which it doesn't have).
     * @param firstScene The name of the Scene loaded when the game starts, or null to load none.
     */
    fun createManagers(isInSceneEditor: Boolean = false, firstScene: String? = null): List<Manager> {
        val managers = listOf<Manager>(
            EveryManager(isInSceneEditor),
            Hud(isInSceneEditor),
        )
        val pluginManagers = if (isInSceneEditor) {
            emptyList()
        } else {
            listOf<Manager>(
                CollisionManager.newInstance(),
                KeyboardInputManager.newInstance(),
                MusicManager.newInstance(),
                SoundManager.newInstance(),
            )
        }
        return pluginManagers + listOf(GeneratedScenes(firstSceneOverride ?: firstScene, isInSceneEditor, managers.filterIsInstance<Actor>()), GeneratedAudio(isInSceneEditor), SpriteManager.newInstance()) + managers
    }
}
